texts.preamble: Satishkumar Ashabhai Patel S/O ... vs State Of Gujarat & on 2 December, 2016 Author: Sonia Gokani Bench: Sonia Gokani C/Sca/18535/2015 Orde In The High Court Of Gujarat At Ahmedabad Special Civil Application No. 18535 of 2015 ========================================================== Satishkumar Ashabhai Patel S/O Ashabhai Patel & 8....Petitioner(s) Versus State Of Gujarat & 1....Respondent(s) ========================================================== Appearance: Mr Anand L Sharma, Advocate for the Petitioner(s) No. 1 - 9 Government Pleader for the Respondent(s) No. 1 Mr Premal R Joshi, Advocate for the Respondent(s) No. 2 = == == == = == = = = = = == = = = = = Coram: Honourable Ms Justice Sonia Gokani Date : 02/12/2016 Oral Order
texts.facts: 1. During the course of hearing, it emerges that no quota is prescribed in the cadre of Designated Officers, Class-I, in the General State Service in the Commissionerate of Food and Drugs Control Administration Recruitment Rules, 2013, for two source of recruitment. It is submitted that as per the provision of section 36 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, it is mandatory to have a Designated Officer for each District to complete the process of enforcement of the Act. However, the Food Safety and Standards Rules, 2011, which came into effect on 05th August, 2011, the State Government created the post of Designated Officers as mentioned in detail hereafter. There are total 27 posts of Designated Officers, Class-I, out of which 23 posts are advertised with intention of filling by direct selection through Gujarat Public Service Satishkumar Ashabhai Patel S/O ... vs State Of Gujarat & on 2 December, 2016 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/139972649/ 1 Commission. These posts were created by parts, over a period between the year 2013-14 and 1015-16. In the fist instance 20 posts in 2012-13, 5 posts during the year 2013-14 by the orders dated 24-05-2012 and 17-06- 2013. These posts were created keeping in view total 25 Districts at the time. Moreover 2 additional post of Designated Officers were created during the year 2015-16 keeping in view the new Districts created.
